pages.quiz:
ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 19
   C. 23
   D. 17

2. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

3. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 5
   D. 25

4. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 11

5. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

6. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 13

7. Solve for x: x + 7 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 8
   C. 7
   D. 15

8. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 36

9. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 3, 6, 9
   B. 2, 4, 6
   C. 1, 2, 3, 6
   D. 1, 6

10. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

11. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 24

12. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 16
   C. 0
   D. 17

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — 17
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 8² + 15²
3. c² = 64 + 225
4. c² = 289
5. c = 17
Final Answer: 17 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse

2. A — 10

3. D — 25
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 5² = 5 × 5
3. 5² = 25
Final Answer: 25
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

4. A — 121
Working:

2. Substitute values: 11² = 11 × 11
3. 11² = 121

Working:

2. Substitute values: x = 15 − 7
3. x = 8
Final Answer: x = 8
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 6 × 6

Final Answer: 36 m²

Working:

2. Substitute values: Product = 4 × 4

Final Answer: 16
